headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 9, 2026**
article:
The Milwaukee Brewers secured a thrilling 4-3 victory over the St. Louis Cardinals, with Jacob Misiorowski earning the win after 7.0 innings of work. Abner Uribe sealed the deal with a save. In another Brewers' win, the team dominated the Cardinals 10-2, with Robert Gasser leading the pitching effort.

Several players are dealing with injuries, impacting their teams' lineups. The San Diego Padres placed Samad Taylor on the 10-day injured list due to a right oblique strain. The Minnesota Twins placed Marco Raya on the 15-day injured list retroactive to July 5, 2026, with a right shoulder impingement. The Pittsburgh Pirates have multiple injured players, including Endy Rodríguez, who was placed on the 10-day injured list retroactive to July 6, 2026, with a left glute strain.

The MLB trade market has been active, with several teams making roster moves. The New York Mets acquired Matt Seelinger from the Detroit Tigers for cash. The Detroit Tigers traded Woo-Suk Go to the Minnesota Twins for cash. The Philadelphia Phillies traded Ryan Degges to the Cleveland Guardians for cash. The Houston Astros traded Tom Cosgrove to the Washington Nationals for cash.

top_news.title: **Brewers Edge Cardinals in Thrilling 4-3 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Milwaukee Brewers secured a narrow win over the St. Louis Cardinals, with Jacob Misiorowski earning the win after 7.0 innings of work, striking out 11 batters and allowing 3 earned runs. Abner Uribe sealed the deal with a save.

top_news.title: **Brewers Blast Past Cardinals 10-2**
top_news.summary: The Milwaukee Brewers dominated the St. Louis Cardinals, securing a 10-2 victory. Robert Gasser led the Brewers' pitching effort with 7.2 innings pitched, striking out 4 and allowing 2 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Cubs Take Down Orioles 5-2**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs secured a 5-2 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Matthew Boyd earning the win after pitching 6.0 innings with 7 strikeouts and 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Athletics Fall to Tigers in 6-2 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers took down the Athletics with a 6-2 final score, securing their win. Colt Keith led the Tigers' offense with a home run and two RBIs.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Shut Out Giants 10-0**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays dominated the San Francisco Giants in a lopsided 10-0 victory, with multiple players contributing to the team's high-scoring performance. Impact hitters for the Blue Jays included Nathan Lukes, Vladimir Guerrero Jr., George Springer, Daulton Varsho, and Kazuma Okamoto.

top_news.title: **Braves Shut Out Pirates in Dominant Performance**
top_news.summary: The Atlanta Braves secured a 3-0 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, marking a strong win for the team. Jared Jones and the Braves' pitching staff played a key role in the shutout, while Joey Bart contributed to the offense.

top_news.title: **Padres Place Samad Taylor on 10-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: San Diego Padres left fielder Samad Taylor has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a right oblique strain.

top_news.title: **Mets Acquire RHP Matt Seelinger in Trade**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets have acquired right-handed pitcher Matt Seelinger from the Detroit Tigers in exchange for cash.
